title: Night aircraft spotting with Lear outside Tonopah

tellings.quote: out in the desert in the middle of the night with binoculars and stuff try- outside of Tonopah.

plain: In the 1980s he went out into the Nevada desert at night with binoculars, outside the town of Tonopah, to watch for secret aircraft, says Bob Lazar, a man who has long said he worked on alien craft in Nevada. He tells Michels he did this with a man named John Lear, "out in the desert in the middle of the night with binoculars and stuff." He tells it as part of how he came to be looking at what the military was flying out there.
